## About
Doc Automotive is a repair shop serving the Broomfield community. We handle maintenance and repair for cars, trucks, SUVs and hybrids, and the work is done by ASE certified technicians using top quality parts.
We treat every customer with respect and fairness, and we keep you in the loop with prompt, friendly communication. When your vehicle is on the lift, we'll always do a courtesy safety and maintenance inspection.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 233 reviews. One customer said Jesse and Tammara kept him informed throughout the process, another said Cruz had his control arms done quick, and another wrote that she never feels talked down to here.

## Services
- Tire Repair and Wheel Alignment Services: New tires, fitting and balancing, and alignment designed to reduce tire wear and improve fuel efficiency.
- Auto Brake Service: Brake work for your car, truck or SUV.
- Auto AC & Heating Services: AC repair and heating work to keep the cabin comfortable.
- CV Joint Repair and Replacement Services: Repair or replacement when your CV joints need it.
- Oil Change Services: Oil changes, plus a courtesy safety and maintenance inspection while it's on the lift.
- Steering and Suspension Services: Steering and suspension repair to keep the ride smooth and the handling right.
- Check Engine Diagnostic and Repairs: Check engine light on? We use top of the line diagnostic tools to find the cause and fix it.
- Electrical System Diagnostic and Repair: Tracking down and fixing electrical problems.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, SUVs and hybrids. We offer a full range of maintenance and repair for all of them.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Walk-ins are always welcome.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Friday 7:30 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I book online?
A: Yes. You can book your appointment online using our scheduling app.

Q: Is there a discount for first responders, educators or healthcare workers?
A: Ask us about our first responder, educator and healthcare worker discount.
